notes: Desktop unit, not rack-mountable (rackUnits set to 0/omitted in practice). HDMI is confirmed HDMI 2.0 (4096x2160@60Hz, HDCP 2.2, HDR) on both console output and all 4 computer inputs. USB hub ports and computer-side USB Type-B ports are USB 3.1 Gen 1 (5Gbps, mapped to usb-5g); keyboard/mouse console ports are USB 2.0 Type-A. RS-232 control uses an RJ-11 jack (closest available connector id is 'rs232'; physically it is RJ-11, not DB9 — noted as caveat). Audio: console side has 2x 3.5mm "Speaker Audio Jack" (labeled output-direction, green) and computer side has 4x 3.5mm "Audio Jack" (one per PC, feeding into the switch as input) — manufacturer material does not explicitly document microphone/bidirectional capability on these jacks, so they are modeled as speaker-out (console) and audio-in (per-PC) only; no grade applies to analog audio or RS-232/power connectors per spec rules. Power is an external DC 5V adapter via barrel jack (2.535W consumption). Sources: manufacturer product page https://iogear.com/products/gcs1934h and support page https://support.iogear.com/product/GCS1934H (specs identical/consistent across both).
